items.text: Awful, awful, awful, headache inducing, over complicated, overcluttered mess in the worst possible graphics style for a game like this. Gave me a migraine just trying to figure out what I was looking at. Starter missions were useless at communicating basic game mechanics so I had no framework to build on to figure out how the game worked. A horrible 40 minutes which is a shame because the premise is fantastic.
items.text_zh: 糟糕，糟糕，糟糕，让人头疼，过于复杂，过度杂乱的一团乱麻，而且采用了对于这类游戏来说最糟糕的图形风格。光是试图弄清楚我在看什么就让我偏头痛发作。新手任务在传达基本游戏机制方面毫无用处，所以我没有任何框架可以在此基础上弄清楚游戏是如何运作的。可怕的40分钟，真可惜，因为前提设定非常棒。

observations.description: 游戏引发头痛和偏头痛
